ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 3:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central regions of both lobes consist of contiguous white pixel blocks; black marginal banding is observed along the entire visible trailing edge and the leading edge of the right lobe (image left); small dark pixel mottling clusters are localized in the center-left and far-right distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 115 degrees; the vertex is partially obscured by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary featuring high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 8 pixels across the trailing edge span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges transitioning to sharply tapered distal tips; trailing edges exhibit a sigmoidal curve with moderate concavity approaching the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized cluster of low-intensity yellow-brown pixels (staining) on the proximal ventral surface of the right lobe (image left) near the water line.
